instance.name: a176
instance.assembly: gzip-installed snapshot instance (uploads = the live files); plugins symlinked to this checkout; after the rework: `PHP=/opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.3/bin/php just present a176` and `just windpress-compile a176` (cache recompiled 1792073447 -> 1792078648, anchor classes present), `just serve a176` for the engine/Genie the e2e runner health-checks

checks.name: EN page: 200, tab counts, rows, thumbnails, chips, config, script
checks.result: HTTP 200; tab counts FAQ 288 / Documents 159; 288 question rows, 159 document rows, every row carries `linker-library-doc has-tile`, 147 rows carry a page image (12 keep the type tile inside the same slot), 7 type chips, the JSON config and the script present

checks.name: DE page: 200 and its own German words (independent writing, not a translation of EN)
checks.result: HTTP 200; H1 'Antworten und Dokumente.', zones 'Vor der Bestellung' / 'Produktantworten' / 'Marken', tabs FAQ 288 / Dokumente 160, placeholder 'Fragen und Dokumente suchen', counter '448 im Bestand', aria-labels 'Auf dieser Seite'

checks.name: S1 (review blocker): a row without a thumbnail keeps the same 52x72 slot as a row with one
checks.result: @1440: 159 rows, all with `has-tile`; both kinds share `grid-template-columns: 52px 790.8px 111.2px` and `grid-template-areas: "thumb lead dl" "thumb meta dl"`; heights 101-102px with an image, 102px with the type tile (was 155 vs 102). @390 the tile column is still 52px and type-tile rows measure 203-204px against 143-264px for image rows (the spread is text wrapping).

checks.name: Anchor landing = target top at or below the sticky stack's bottom edge
checks.result: @1440 margin +13px (target top 150 vs sticky bottom 137); @390 margin +24px with the chip row pinned (206 vs 182). The e2e spec asserts `top >= sticky - 1` and that the page actually scrolled, at 1440 and 390, EN and DE.

checks.name: Language pill's accessible name (the review asked whether it is the bare code)
checks.command: playwright ariaSnapshot() on a document row's .linker-library-lang, EN and DE
checks.result: EN page: innerHTML `ENEnglish`, accessible text 'English'. DE page: accessible text 'Englisch'. The bare code is aria-hidden decoration; the mapping to the full name is already what the reader gets, so the copy record documents it rather than changing it.

checks.name: The search's flat list is the active tab's half (regression the new e2e caught)
checks.result: before the fix: a documents-only query listed 4 hits on the FAQ tab and only 1 of them was a document row. After: the FAQ half shows its own rows (0 for a documents-only query, with the empty state) and the documents tab lists the other half; checked in the e2e spec and in tests/js/library-ui.test.mjs.

checks.name: WindPress compiled cache: the page's rules, its anchor classes and its own scroll-margin
checks.result: the page's rule blocks are in the shipped cache; the three anchor classes present (.linker-library-tabbar, .linker-library-card, .linker-library-thumb); the page's own `scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--ll-header-h) + var(--ll-sticky) + 12px)` rules present

checks.name: linker-commerce: PHPCS, PHPStan, PHPUnit
checks.command: cd plugins/linker-commerce && PHP=/opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.3/bin/php vendor/bin/phpcs -q && vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=-1 && vendor/bin/phpunit
checks.result: phpcs clean; PHPStan 0 errors; PHPUnit OK (1037 tests, 5018 assertions, 54 skipped — the skips are the instance-needing integration tests). New this round: DocumentThumbnailsTest (5), TradeRulesTest (4), plus the manifest-hit and constant-slot cases in LibraryPageTest, and the config's dead keys asserted absent.

checks.name: The plugins' script tests (node --test, jsdom through plugins/linker-tools)
checks.result: # tests 36 / pass 36 / fail 0 (22 of them library-ui.test.mjs, incl. the new guards: aria-pressed belongs to the chips alone; every cloned row keeps its tile slot; the rail's mark reads data-library-zone off the elements; a tab switch re-halves the search list)

checks.name: tools/faq: the thumbnail pipeline's own tests and the Python gates
checks.command: cd tools/faq && uv run --locked pytest -q && uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked mypy .
checks.result: 20 tests pass (11 of test_thumbs.py: key/file_name/webp_size/is_pdf, the cap's select(), the probe-only branch driving main() and proving nothing is written, the cleanup rule, and the committed manifest's mutual consistency with the committed files); ruff clean and formatted; mypy clean

checks.name: The shipped data file is the extraction it claims to be
checks.result: the committed data/faq-trade.json matches the templates at 08997063 byte for byte (tools/faq/extract-trade.py is the extractor now, with the revision and a --check mode)

checks.name: e2e: the page's own suite (tests/e2e/specs/faq-download.spec.ts)
checks.result: 10 passed (13.5s), EN and DE: the tab switch and the URL round-trip (faq takes no parameter, documents is recorded, reload and back both land right), the search with its split counts (a tab switch re-halves the list, clearing restores the register), 20 rows a page with the last page short and aria-current on the pager, the type chips filtering every visible row and updating the counts, and the anchor landing at or below the sticky stack at 1440 and 390

checks.name: i18n gates and the banned-word gate
checks.command: python3 tools/checks/i18n-coverage.py && python3 tools/checks/i18n-validity.py && just banned-words
checks.result: clean (the 15 new strings all carry a German msgstr; catalogs compile), banned-words clean

checks.result: `.gitignore:34:.scratch/faq-pdf-cache/` ignores it; the prototype copy (.scratch/faq-wt) and the scratch extractor are removed from the worktree, and the extractor now lives in tools/faq/extract-trade.py
